sources.title: CBC News — 2019 southern Vancouver Island office pay, preserved by View Royal
sources.locator: PDF physical pages 16–17; Schedule 2, March 23, 2021 report, printed pages 4–5 of 6
notes: CBC article published November 21, 2019. The preserved charts show southern Vancouver Island only.
Sources were remuneration bylaws and financial disclosures. Where councillor remuneration varied, CBC used the mean; this differs from the 2021 survey's most-common-value statistic.
Most values are 2019; chart asterisks denote 2018. None of the included municipality labels has an asterisk.

Seventeen mayor amounts are printed inside the bars. Three exact councillor amounts are specified in the report prose. Fourteen other councillor bars have no numeric value label and are excluded; no amount is inferred from bar length.
Original report downloaded and chart pages rendered for visual verification. The source hash identifies the downloaded PDF.
